posts.title: Trying out running LLM on my Macbook
posts.description: It's a little bit late to the party to start testing Local LLM deployment using homebrew install ollama but hey it's better late than never. I browse around to decide which model to test out using canirun.ai . it's a useful tool to have a glimpse on what LLMs your machine could handle. Mine is a Apple M2 Pro Chip with 16GB vram. Not powerful but it could handle some decent LLM in the early 2026. I
